source.text: Ἐχάρην δὲ ἐν κυρίῳ μεγάλως ὅτι ἤδη ποτὲ ἀνεθάλετε τὸ ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ φρονεῖν, ἐφ’ ᾧ καὶ ἐφρονεῖτε ἠκαιρεῖσθε δέ.

records.literal_gloss: I rejoiced and in [the] Lord greatly that now at last you blossomed again the on behalf of me to think, on which also you were thinking, you were lacking opportunity however.

en.L: And I rejoiced in [the] Lord greatly that now at last you have blossomed again in thinking of me; [you were] indeed thinking [of me], but you lacked opportunity.
en.B: It brought me great joy in the Lord that now at last your care for me has come into bloom again. You had been caring all along; you simply had no chance to show it.
en.R: I am so glad in the Lord that your care for me has blossomed again, like a plant that flowers again after a dry season. I know you cared about me the whole time, but you had no chance to show it.

es.L: Y me alegré en [el] Señor grandemente de que ya por fin {{plural_you:hayan reverdecido|hayáis reverdecido}} en pensar en mí; de hecho {{plural_you:pensaban|pensabais}} [en ello], pero {{plural_you:les faltaba|os faltaba}} la oportunidad.
es.B: Me alegré mucho en el Señor de que por fin {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} cariño por mí haya vuelto a florecer. En realidad siempre {{plural_you:se preocupaban|os preocupabais}} por mí; solo que no {{plural_you:tenían|teníais}} ocasión de demostrarlo.
es.R: Me alegro mucho en el Señor de que {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} cariño por mí haya vuelto a florecer, como una planta que florece de nuevo después de la sequía. Sé que todo el tiempo {{plural_you:se preocupaban|os preocupabais}} por mí, pero no {{plural_you:tenían|teníais}} cómo demostrarlo.

fr.L: Or je me suis grandement réjoui dans le Seigneur de ce que maintenant enfin vous avez refleuri dans votre pensée pour moi ; vous y pensiez bien, mais l’occasion vous manquait.
fr.B: J’ai éprouvé une grande joie dans le Seigneur en voyant que maintenant enfin votre souci de moi a refleuri. Vous vous souciiez de moi depuis toujours, mais vous n’aviez pas l’occasion de le montrer.
fr.R: Je suis si content dans le Seigneur : l’attention que vous me portez a fleuri de nouveau, comme une plante qui refleurit après la saison sèche. Je sais que vous avez pensé à moi tout le temps, mais vous n’avez pas eu l’occasion de le montrer.

sw.L: Nilifurahi mno katika Bwana kwamba sasa mwishowe kunifikiria kwenu kumechipuka upya; kwa kweli mlikuwa mkinifikiria, ila mlikosa fursa.
sw.B: Ilinifurahisha sana katika Bwana kwamba sasa hatimaye kujali kwenu kwa ajili yangu kumechanua tena. Mlikuwa mkinijali muda wote; ila hamkupata nafasi ya kuonyesha hivyo.
sw.R: Ninafurahi sana katika Bwana kwamba kujali kwenu kwa ajili yangu kumechanua tena, kama mmea unaotoa maua tena baada ya kiangazi. Najua mlikuwa mkinijali muda wote, lakini hamkupata nafasi ya kuonyesha hivyo.

ko.L: 여러분이 이제 마침내 나를 생각하는 마음이 다시 꽃피었으니 내가 주님 안에서 크게 기뻐했습니다. 여러분은 [나를] 생각하고 있었으나 기회가 없었던 것입니다.
ko.B: 이제 마침내 나를 생각하는 여러분의 마음이 다시 꽃을 피웠으니, 나는 주님 안에서 크게 기뻐했습니다. 여러분은 줄곧 나를 생각하고 있었지만, 그것을 보여 줄 기회가 없었을 뿐입니다.
ko.R: 나를 위하는 여러분의 마음이 다시 꽃을 피웠으니, 나는 주님 안에서 정말 기쁩니다. 마치 가뭄이 지난 뒤에 식물이 다시 꽃을 피우는 것과 같습니다. 나는 여러분이 줄곧 나를 생각하고 있었지만, 그것을 보여 줄 기회가 없었다는 것을 압니다.

vi.L: Tôi rất vui mừng trong Chúa vì bây giờ, sau cùng, anh chị em lại nảy nở lòng lo nghĩ cho tôi; thật anh chị em vẫn lo nghĩ, nhưng không có dịp.
vi.B: Tôi rất vui mừng trong Chúa vì bây giờ, sau cùng, lòng quan tâm của anh chị em đối với tôi lại nở hoa. Anh chị em vẫn luôn quan tâm, chỉ là không có dịp để bày tỏ.
vi.R: Tôi rất vui trong Chúa vì lòng quan tâm của anh chị em đối với tôi lại nở hoa, như một cây lại trổ hoa sau mùa khô hạn. Tôi biết lúc nào anh chị em cũng quan tâm đến tôi, nhưng không có dịp để bày tỏ.

pt.L: Alegrei-me, porém, muito no Senhor porque agora, finalmente, vocês voltaram a florescer no pensar em mim; [vocês] de fato pensavam [em mim], mas lhes faltava oportunidade.
pt.B: Foi grande a alegria que senti no Senhor porque agora, enfim, o cuidado de vocês por mim voltou a florescer. Vocês sempre se importaram comigo; só não tinham tido oportunidade de mostrar isso.
pt.R: Fico muito alegre no Senhor porque o cuidado de vocês por mim floresceu de novo, como uma planta que volta a dar flores depois de um tempo de seca. Sei que vocês se importaram comigo o tempo todo, mas não tinham tido chance de mostrar isso.

am.L: በጌታም እጅግ ደስ አለኝ፤ አሁን በመጨረሻ ስለ እኔ ማሰባችሁ እንደ ገና አቆጥቁጧልና፤ ስለዚያም በእርግጥ ታስቡ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን አጋጣሚ አጣችሁ።
am.B: አሁን በመጨረሻ ለእኔ ያላችሁ አሳቢነት እንደ ገና በማበቡ በጌታ እጅግ ደስ አለኝ። ሁልጊዜም ታስቡልኝ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ይህን ለማሳየት አጋጣሚ አላገኛችሁም።
am.R: ከበጋ ወራት በኋላ ዳግም እንደሚያብብ ተክል ለእኔ ያላችሁ አሳቢነት እንደ ገና ስላበበ በጌታ በጣም ደስ ብሎኛል። ሁልጊዜም ታስቡልኝ እንደ ነበር አውቃለሁ፤ ነገር ግን ለማሳየት አጋጣሚ አላገኛችሁም።

decisions.choice: blossomed again, like a plant putting out new growth
decisions.reason: ἀναθάλλω is used of plants that sprout or flower again. Paul pictures their care for him as a plant coming back into flower after a season without blossom. It is not a rebuke for letting their care die: the end of the verse says they cared all along.

decisions.choice: now at last: after a long gap
alternatives: now finally, after you neglected me
decisions.reason: The words mark a long interval since their last gift. Paul explains the gap at once as a lack of opportunity, not a lack of love.

decisions.choice: you were concerned all along, but had no opportunity
alternatives: you were concerned about the matter, but the time was not right
decisions.reason: The words "for which" point back to their concern for Paul. ἀκαιρέομαι means to lack a fitting time. Paul does not say what stood in the way: distance, a messenger, or their own deep poverty, which 2 Corinthians 8:2 mentions in the churches of Macedonia.

decisions.choice: joy in the Lord, not only in the money
decisions.reason: Paul's joy is "in the Lord", the phrase of 4:4. He was glad because their gift showed the Lord at work in them; verses 11 and 17 make clear he is not rejoicing over the money as such.

decisions.choice: come into bloom again (B); blossomed again, like a plant (R)
decisions.reason: "Revived" loses the picture of a plant flowering again. Readable spells the picture out as a comparison; "after a dry season" adds only what the image itself implies.

decisions.choice: to show it
decisions.reason: The Greek says only that they lacked opportunity. Verses 14-18 show that the opportunity was to act on their care by sending help, so Balanced and Readable add "to show it".

decisions.choice: reverdecer (L); volver a florecer (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Revivir" loses the picture of a plant flowering again. Literal uses "reverdecer", the one Spanish verb for a plant coming back to life; Balanced and Readable say "volver a florecer", which also fits "cariño" as its subject. Readable spells the picture out as a comparison, as English does.

decisions.choice: demostrarlo
decisions.reason: As in English: the Greek says only that they lacked opportunity, and verses 14-18 show it was the opportunity to act on their care.

decisions.choice: ustedes / vosotros forms
decisions.reason: As in 4:1: Paul writes in the plural, so each plural "you" and its verb is a reader setting, ustedes (Latin America, the default) or vosotros (Spain).

decisions.choice: "다시 꽃피다" at every level, Readable adding the picture of a plant after a dry season
decisions.reason: The verb means to blossom again, like a plant putting out new growth (the meaning decision). Korean "꽃피다" keeps the picture at every level, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "nảy nở" (L); "nở hoa" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb is to blossom again, like a plant putting out new growth (m1). Vietnamese keeps the picture of a plant; Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting for capitalised pronouns has nothing to change; pronouns for God are written plainly through the passage.

decisions.choice: አቆጠቆጠ (sprouted again, L); አበበ (bloomed, B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek pictures a plant putting out new growth (meaning decision m1); Amharic has the same picture in "አቆጠቆጠ" and "አበበ", so it is kept rather than flattened.

source.text: οὐχ ὅτι καθ’ ὑστέρησιν λέγω, ἐγὼ γὰρ ἔμαθον ἐν οἷς εἰμι αὐτάρκης εἶναι·

records.literal_gloss: Not that according to need I speak, I for learned in [the things] in which I am content to be;

en.L: Not that I speak according to need, for I have learned to be content in whatever [circumstances] I am.
en.B: I do not say this because I am going short. However things stand with me, I have learned to be content.
en.R: I am not saying this because I am short of anything. I have learned to be content with what I have, whatever happens to me.

es.L: No que hable por necesidad, porque yo he aprendido a estar contento en [las circunstancias] en que estoy.
es.B: No digo esto porque esté pasando necesidad. He aprendido a estar contento sea cual sea mi situación.
es.R: No lo digo porque me falte algo. He aprendido a estar contento con lo que tengo, pase lo que pase.

fr.L: Non que je parle selon le besoin, car moi, j’ai appris à être content dans les [circonstances] où je suis.
fr.B: Je ne dis pas cela parce que je suis dans le manque. Quelle que soit ma situation, j’ai appris à être satisfait.
fr.R: Je ne dis pas cela parce qu’il me manque quelque chose. J’ai appris à être content de ce que j’ai, quoi qu’il m’arrive.

sw.L: Sisemi hivi kwa kuwa nimepungukiwa, kwa maana nimejifunza kutosheka katika [hali] ile niliyomo.
sw.B: Sisemi haya kwa sababu nimepungukiwa. Kwa vyovyote mambo yalivyo kwangu, nimejifunza kutosheka.
sw.R: Sisemi hivi kwa sababu ninakosa kitu. Nimejifunza kutosheka na nilicho nacho, lolote linalonipata.

ko.L: 내가 궁핍해서 말하는 것이 아닙니다. 나는 어떤 [형편]에 있든지 자족하는 것을 배웠기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 내가 무엇이 모자라서 이렇게 말하는 것은 아닙니다. 나는 어떤 형편에 있든지 만족하는 법을 배웠습니다.
ko.R: 내가 무엇이 부족해서 이 말을 하는 것이 아닙니다. 나는 무슨 일이 일어나든지 내가 가진 것으로 만족하는 법을 배웠습니다.

vi.L: Không phải tôi nói vì túng thiếu, vì tôi đã học được cách tự thấy đủ trong bất cứ hoàn cảnh nào tôi gặp.
vi.B: Tôi nói điều này không phải vì tôi thiếu thốn. Dù hoàn cảnh tôi thế nào, tôi đã học được cách thấy đủ.
vi.R: Tôi nói vậy không phải vì tôi đang thiếu thứ gì. Tôi đã học được cách bằng lòng với những gì mình có, dù chuyện gì xảy ra cho tôi.

pt.L: Não que eu fale por necessidade, pois eu aprendi a estar contente em qualquer [situação] em que estou.
pt.B: Não digo isso porque esteja passando necessidade. Seja qual for a minha situação, aprendi a estar contente.
pt.R: Não estou dizendo isso porque esteja faltando alguma coisa para mim. Aprendi a estar contente com o que tenho, aconteça o que acontecer.

am.L: ስለ ችግር እንደምናገር አይደለም፤ እኔ ባለሁበት ሁኔታ ሁሉ የሚበቃኝ ሆኜ መኖርን ተምሬአለሁና።
am.B: ይህን የምለው ስለ ጎደለኝ አይደለም። ነገሮች ምንም ቢሆኑ ባለኝ ረክቼ መኖርን ተምሬአለሁ።
am.R: ይህን የምናገረው አንዳች ስለ ጎደለኝ አይደለም። ምንም ቢደርስብኝ ባለኝ ነገር መርካትን ተምሬአለሁ።

decisions.choice: not because I am in want
alternatives: not as a complaint about poverty
decisions.reason: Paul makes sure his thanks are not taken as a hint that he needs more. This is the first of two such disclaimers; the second is in verse 17.

decisions.choice: content: having enough, not ruled by circumstances
decisions.reason: αὐτάρκης was a favorite word of Stoic and Cynic teachers for the wise person who needs nothing outside himself. Paul uses the word but not the idea of self-reliance: verse 13 says his strength comes from the one who strengthens him. He means having enough, whatever he has.

decisions.choice: learned through experience
decisions.reason: The contentment was not a natural temperament. Paul learned it through the hardships he lists in 2 Corinthians 11:23-27.

decisions.choice: in whatever circumstances I am in
alternatives: among whatever people I am with
decisions.reason: The pronoun could refer to people or to things. Verse 12, with its plenty and want, shows Paul means his circumstances.

decisions.choice: content
decisions.reason: "Self-sufficient" suggests not needing anyone, the opposite of verse 13. "Content" says having enough. Readable adds "with what I have" to make that plain.

decisions.choice: going short
decisions.reason: ὑστέρησις is lack or shortage; "going short" says it in everyday words.

decisions.choice: contento
decisions.reason: Spanish "autosuficiente" has the same problem as English "self-sufficient": it suggests needing no one, the opposite of verse 13. "Contento" says having enough. "Satisfecho" was also possible, but can suggest being pleased with oneself.

decisions.choice: content (L, R); satisfait (B)
decisions.reason: As the English decision says, "se suffire à soi-même" would suggest needing no one, the opposite of verse 13. The word means having enough (m2).

decisions.choice: kutosheka (be content)
decisions.reason: "Kutosheka" is to have enough and be satisfied with it, which keeps the Greek idea of being self-sufficient whatever one has; "kuridhika" is also natural and a reviewer may prefer it.

decisions.choice: "자족하다" (L); "만족하다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means having enough, not ruled by circumstances (the meaning decision). Literal uses "자족하다" (be self-sufficient, content), the Korean word built the same way as the Greek; Balanced and Readable say "만족하다", the everyday word.

decisions.choice: "tự thấy đủ" (L), "thấy đủ" (B); "bằng lòng với những gì mình có" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is having enough, not ruled by circumstances (m2). "Thấy đủ" says it plainly; "thỏa lòng" is the older church word and would bring the sentence close to a familiar version.

decisions.choice: contente
decisions.reason: As the English: "autossuficiente" would say that Paul needs no one, the opposite of verse 13 (m2). "Estar contente" is to have enough and be at peace with it.

source.text: οἶδα καὶ ταπεινοῦσθαι, οἶδα καὶ περισσεύειν· ἐν παντὶ καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν μεμύημαι, καὶ χορτάζεσθαι καὶ πεινᾶν, καὶ περισσεύειν καὶ ὑστερεῖσθαι·

records.literal_gloss: I know also to be brought low, I know also to abound; in every and in all I have been initiated, both to be filled and to hunger, both to abound and to lack;

en.L: I know both [how] to be brought low, [and] I know [how] to abound; in everything and in all [things] I have been initiated, both into being filled and into being hungry, both into abounding and into lacking.
en.B: I know how to get by on little, and I know how to handle having plenty. In each and every situation I have been let into the secret: how to eat my fill and how to go hungry, how to have more than enough and how to do without.
en.R: I know how to live with very little, and I know how to live with a lot. I have learned the secret of living in every kind of situation: when I have plenty to eat and when I am hungry, when I have more than I need and when I do not have enough.

es.L: Sé también vivir humildemente, y sé también tener abundancia; en todo y en todas [las cosas] he sido iniciado, tanto en estar saciado como en tener hambre, tanto en tener abundancia como en padecer necesidad.
es.B: Sé vivir con poco y sé vivir con mucho. En todas y cada una de las situaciones he sido iniciado en el secreto: a estar saciado y a pasar hambre, a tener de sobra y a pasar necesidad.
es.R: Sé vivir con muy poco y sé vivir con mucho. He aprendido el secreto de vivir en cualquier situación: cuando tengo de sobra para comer y cuando paso hambre, cuando tengo más de lo que necesito y cuando no me alcanza.

fr.L: Je sais être abaissé, je sais aussi être dans l’abondance ; en tout et en toutes [choses] j’ai été initié à être rassasié et à avoir faim, à être dans l’abondance et à être dans le manque.
fr.B: Je sais me contenter de peu, et je sais aussi vivre dans l’abondance. En toute situation et en toutes choses, j’ai été initié au secret : manger à ma faim et souffrir de la faim, avoir plus qu’assez et me passer de tout.
fr.R: Je sais vivre avec très peu, et je sais vivre avec beaucoup. J’ai appris le secret pour vivre dans toutes sortes de situations : quand j’ai beaucoup à manger et quand j’ai faim, quand j’ai plus que nécessaire et quand je n’ai pas assez.

sw.L: Najua kushushwa chini, na najua kuwa na ziada; katika kila jambo na katika yote nimefundishwa siri: kushiba na kuwa na njaa, kuwa na ziada na kupungukiwa.
sw.B: Najua jinsi ya kuishi na kidogo, na najua jinsi ya kuishi na wingi. Katika kila hali na katika kila jambo nimejifunza siri: jinsi ya kushiba na jinsi ya kuwa na njaa, jinsi ya kuwa na zaidi ya kutosha na jinsi ya kukosa.
sw.R: Najua jinsi ya kuishi na kidogo sana, na najua jinsi ya kuishi na vingi. Nimejifunza siri ya kuishi katika kila aina ya hali: ninapokuwa na chakula tele na ninapokuwa na njaa, ninapokuwa na zaidi ya ninavyohitaji na ninapokuwa sina vya kutosha.

ko.L: 나는 낮아질 줄도 알고, 넉넉할 줄도 압니다. 모든 일과 모든 [형편]에서, 배부름과 배고픔에도, 넉넉함과 궁핍함에도 비결을 배웠습니다.
ko.B: 나는 적게 가지고 사는 법도 알고, 많이 가지고 사는 법도 압니다. 모든 형편, 모든 일에서 나는 그 비결을 배웠습니다. 배부르게 먹는 법도, 굶는 법도, 넉넉하게 가진 법도, 없이 지내는 법도 배웠습니다.
ko.R: 나는 아주 적게 가지고 사는 법도 알고, 많이 가지고 사는 법도 압니다. 나는 어떤 형편에서도 살아가는 비결을 배웠습니다. 먹을 것이 넉넉할 때나 배고플 때나, 필요한 것보다 많이 가졌을 때나 모자랄 때나 살아가는 비결을 배웠습니다.

vi.L: Tôi biết chịu thiếu thốn, cũng biết được dư dật; trong mọi sự và mọi hoàn cảnh, tôi đã được học bí quyết, cả no lẫn đói, cả dư dật lẫn thiếu thốn.
vi.B: Tôi biết sống thiếu thốn, và tôi cũng biết sống dư dật. Trong mọi tình huống, tôi đã học được bí quyết: lúc được no và lúc phải đói, lúc dư dật và lúc thiếu thốn.
vi.R: Tôi biết sống khi có rất ít, và tôi biết sống khi có nhiều. Tôi đã học được bí quyết để sống trong mọi hoàn cảnh: khi có nhiều để ăn và khi bị đói, khi có nhiều hơn mình cần và khi không có đủ.

pt.L: Sei tanto ser rebaixado como sei ter abundância; em tudo e em todas [as coisas] fui iniciado, tanto em estar saciado como em ter fome, tanto em ter abundância como em passar necessidade.
pt.B: Sei viver com pouco e sei lidar com a fartura. Em cada situação, e em todas elas, fui iniciado no segredo: como comer até ficar satisfeito e como passar fome, como ter mais do que o suficiente e como passar sem nada.
pt.R: Sei viver com muito pouco e sei viver com muito. Aprendi o segredo de viver em todo tipo de situação: quando tenho bastante para comer e quando passo fome, quando tenho mais do que preciso e quando não tenho o suficiente.

am.L: ዝቅ ማለትን አውቃለሁ፤ መትረፍረፍንም አውቃለሁ፤ በሁሉ ነገርና በሁሉ ሁኔታ የመጥገብንና የመራብን፣ የመትረፍረፍንና የማጣትን ምሥጢር ተምሬአለሁ።
am.B: በጥቂት መኖርን አውቃለሁ፤ በብዙ መኖርንም አውቃለሁ። በማንኛውም ሁኔታና በሁሉ ነገር ምሥጢሩን ተምሬአለሁ፤ መጥገብንና መራብን፣ ተርፎኝ መኖርንና ጎድሎብኝ መኖርን።
am.R: በጣም ጥቂት ይዤ መኖርን አውቃለሁ፤ ብዙ ይዤ መኖርንም አውቃለሁ። በማንኛውም ዓይነት ሁኔታ የመኖርን ምሥጢር ተምሬአለሁ፤ የምበላው ሲበዛልኝም ስራብም፣ ከሚያስፈልገኝ በላይ ሲኖረኝም በቂ ሳይኖረኝም።

decisions.choice: to be brought low: to live with little
decisions.reason: The word is paired with "to abound", so it is about circumstances, having little, rather than the humble mind Paul commends in 2:3. The same verb is used of Christ in 2:8, who humbled himself.

decisions.choice: I have been initiated: let into a secret
decisions.reason: μυέομαι was the word for being initiated into the secret rites of the mystery cults, well known in the Greek world. Paul uses it only here. It suggests a secret that is learned by being brought through experience. Verse 13 gives the secret.

decisions.choice: in each and every situation
alternatives: in everything and among all people
decisions.reason: Paul uses the same word in the singular and then the plural. The plural could mean "among all people", but the list that follows is about circumstances, so the doubling stresses that no situation is left out.

decisions.choice: two pairs of opposites
decisions.reason: Full and hungry, plenty and lack: Paul names the extremes to say he has been through both, and both are hard to handle well.

decisions.choice: I have been initiated (L); I have been let into the secret (B)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the picture of being initiated rather than an ordinary word for learning. Readable uses plain words; the meaning note gives the image.

decisions.choice: get by on little ... handle having plenty (B); live with very little ... with a lot (R)
decisions.reason: Says in everyday words what the two verbs mean in this context.

decisions.choice: vivir humildemente (L)
decisions.reason: "Ser humillado" would mean being shamed. "Vivir humildemente" means living on little, which is the sense of meaning decision m1, and keeps the root the verb shares with 2:8.

decisions.choice: he sido iniciado (L, B); he aprendido el secreto (R)
decisions.reason: As in English, Literal and Balanced keep the picture of being initiated; Readable uses plain words and leaves the image to the meaning note.

decisions.choice: najua kushushwa ... najua kuwa na ziada, no brackets
decisions.reason: The English Literal brackets "[how]". Swahili "najua" with an infinitive already means "I know how to", so nothing is supplied.

decisions.choice: "비결을 배웠습니다" at every level
decisions.reason: The verb means to be let into a secret, a word from the mystery religions (the meaning decision). "비결" (secret) keeps the picture in plain Korean, and the ending avoids the archaic "-노라" of the older Bibles.

decisions.choice: "đã được học bí quyết" (L), "đã học được bí quyết" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb is to be initiated, let into a secret (m2). "Bí quyết" keeps the sense of a secret learned, which "tập quen" would lose.

decisions.choice: ምሥጢሩን ተምሬአለሁ (I have learned the secret)
alternatives: ተለማምጃለሁ (I have got used to it)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is the one for being initiated into a secret (meaning decision); "ምሥጢር" keeps the sense that contentment is something one is let into, not merely a habit.

source.text: πάντα ἰσχύω ἐν τῷ ἐνδυναμοῦντί με.

records.literal_gloss: All things I have strength for in the [one] strengthening me.

en.L: I have strength for all things in the [one who] strengthens me.
en.B: I have strength for every situation in the one who makes me strong.
en.R: I can face all of it, whether I have plenty or very little, in the strength of the one who makes me strong.

es.L: Para todo tengo fuerzas en el que me fortalece.
es.B: Tengo fuerzas para cualquier situación en aquel que me fortalece.
es.R: Puedo enfrentar todo eso, tenga mucho o tenga muy poco, con la fuerza que me da aquel que me fortalece.

fr.L: Pour toutes choses j’ai la force, en celui qui me rend fort.
fr.B: Je suis capable de faire face à toute situation en celui qui me rend fort.
fr.R: Je peux faire face à tout cela, que j’aie beaucoup ou très peu, grâce à la force de celui qui me rend fort.

sw.L: Kwa mambo yote nina nguvu ndani ya yule anayenitia nguvu.
sw.B: Ninazo nguvu za kukabili kila hali ndani ya yule anayenifanya kuwa na nguvu.
sw.R: Ninaweza kukabili yote hayo, ikiwa nina vingi au vichache, kwa nguvu ya yule anayenitia nguvu.

ko.L: 나는 나를 강하게 하시는 분 안에서 모든 것을 감당할 힘이 있습니다.
ko.B: 나를 강하게 해 주시는 분 안에서, 나는 어떤 형편이든 감당할 힘이 있습니다.
ko.R: 많이 가졌든 적게 가졌든, 나는 그 모든 것을 이겨 낼 수 있습니다. 나를 강하게 해 주시는 분께서 힘을 주시기 때문입니다.

vi.L: Tôi có sức cho mọi sự trong Đấng làm cho tôi mạnh mẽ.
vi.B: Tôi có sức đối diện mọi hoàn cảnh trong Đấng làm cho tôi mạnh mẽ.
vi.R: Tôi có thể đối diện với tất cả những điều ấy, dù có nhiều hay có rất ít, nhờ sức mạnh của Đấng làm cho tôi mạnh mẽ.

pt.L: Tenho força para todas as coisas naquele que me fortalece.
pt.B: Tenho força para enfrentar qualquer situação naquele que me torna forte.
pt.R: Posso enfrentar tudo isso, quer eu tenha muito, quer tenha pouco, com a força daquele que me torna forte.

am.L: በሚያበረታኝ በእርሱ ለሁሉ ነገር ብርቱ ነኝ።
am.B: ብርታትን በሚሰጠኝ በእርሱ ለማንኛውም ሁኔታ ብርቱ ነኝ።
am.R: ብዙ ቢኖረኝም ጥቂት ቢኖረኝም፣ ብርቱ በሚያደርገኝ በእርሱ ኃይል ሁሉን መቋቋም እችላለሁ።

decisions.choice: all things: every circumstance just described
alternatives: anything at all I set out to do
decisions.reason: The sentence completes verses 11-12. "All things" are the conditions Paul has just listed: eating well and going hungry, having plenty and going without. He is saying he can live through any of them and stay content, not that he has unlimited ability. Lifted out of its setting the verse is often heard as a promise of success in any task; the context does not support that.

decisions.choice: have strength for, be equal to
decisions.reason: ἰσχύω means to be strong or capable. With an object it means to be strong enough for something, to cope with it.

decisions.choice: in the one who strengthens me: strength that comes from being joined to him
alternatives: by means of the one who strengthens me
decisions.reason: The preposition can mean "in" or "by". Either way the strength is not Paul's own. Where Stoic teachers spoke of a self-sufficient person (verse 11), Paul's sufficiency comes from someone else.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "the one who strengthens me"
decisions.reason: The oldest manuscripts have no name here; many later ones, followed by the King James Version, add "Christ". The added word names the one Paul almost certainly means: in 1 Timothy 1:12 Christ Jesus strengthens Paul with the same verb, ἐνδυναμόω. So the meaning hardly changes.

decisions.choice: every situation (B); all of it, whether I have plenty or very little (R)
decisions.reason: "All things" on its own is easily heard as a promise of unlimited ability. Balanced says what the context shows "all things" means, and Readable repeats the contrast from verse 12. Literal keeps "all things". Reviewers should check whether Balanced should keep the wider "all things" and leave the context to the note.

decisions.choice: para todo tengo fuerzas (L); para cualquier situación (B); todo eso, tenga mucho o tenga muy poco (R)
decisions.reason: "Todo lo puedo" is the best-known Spanish wording of this verse and is widely quoted as a promise of success in any task, the reading meaning decision m1 rejects. Literal keeps "todo" but says "tengo fuerzas", which is closer to the verb. Balanced and Readable follow the English choices. Reviewers should check whether Balanced should keep "todo" and leave the context to the note.

decisions.choice: yule anayenitia nguvu
decisions.reason: "The one who strengthens me" is said with the demonstrative "yule", as the English says "the one" without a capital, so there is no deity_pronoun span; the sentence also stays clear of the familiar wording of this verse.

decisions.choice: "모든 것을 감당할 힘이 있습니다" (L); "어떤 형편이든 감당할 힘이 있습니다" (B); "그 모든 것을 이겨 낼 수 있습니다" (R)
decisions.reason: "All things" are the circumstances just described, and the verb means to have strength for, to be equal to (the meaning decisions). "감당하다" (to bear, to cope with) says that; "모든 것을 할 수 있다" (can do anything) is how the verse is often misread.

decisions.choice: "Tôi có sức cho mọi sự trong Đấng làm cho tôi mạnh mẽ" (L); "đối diện mọi hoàn cảnh" (B, R)
alternatives: "Tôi làm được mọi sự nhờ Đấng ban thêm sức cho tôi"
decisions.reason: "All things" are the circumstances just described (m1), not any task at all, so Balanced and Readable say "every situation", as the English does. The well-known older wording ("làm được mọi sự") would widen the meaning, and the style guide asks for our own wording.

decisions.choice: Tenho força para todas as coisas (L); para enfrentar qualquer situação (B); Posso enfrentar tudo isso (R)
decisions.reason: The familiar "Tudo posso" is heard in Brazil as a promise of unlimited ability, which m1 rules out: "all things" are the circumstances of verse 12. Literal keeps "todas as coisas" with the verb's sense of being strong enough for something (m2).

decisions.choice: ለሁሉ ነገር ብርቱ ነኝ (I am strong for all things, L); ለማንኛውም ሁኔታ (for every situation, B); ሁሉን መቋቋም እችላለሁ (I can face all of it, R)
alternatives: ሁሉን እችላለሁ (I can do all things)
decisions.reason: 'All things' are the circumstances of verse 12, plenty and want (meaning decision m1), and the verb means being equal to them; the familiar "ሁሉን እችላለሁ" reads as a promise of unlimited ability. The text followed has no name, only 'the one who strengthens me', so none is added.

source.text: πλὴν καλῶς ἐποιήσατε συγκοινωνήσαντές μου τῇ θλίψει.

records.literal_gloss: Nevertheless well you did having shared together of me the affliction.

en.L: Nevertheless, you did well, sharing together in my affliction.
en.B: All the same, you did a fine thing when you took a share in my hardship.
en.R: Even so, you did the right thing when you shared my hard times with me.

es.L: Sin embargo, bien {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} participando juntamente en mi aflicción.
es.B: Con todo, {{plural_you:hicieron bien en hacerse|hicisteis bien en haceros}} partícipes de mis dificultades.
es.R: Aun así, {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} muy bien en acompañarme en mis tiempos difíciles.

fr.L: Cependant vous avez bien fait de prendre part avec moi à ma détresse.
fr.B: Malgré tout, vous avez bien agi en prenant votre part de mes difficultés.
fr.R: Pourtant, vous avez bien fait de partager avec moi mes moments difficiles.

sw.L: Hata hivyo, mlitenda vizuri mkishirikiana nami katika taabu yangu.
sw.B: Hata hivyo, mlifanya jambo zuri mlipojitwika sehemu ya taabu yangu.
sw.R: Hata hivyo, mlifanya jambo jema mliposhiriki nami nyakati zangu ngumu.

ko.L: 그러나 여러분이 나의 환난에 함께 참여한 것은 잘한 일입니다.
ko.B: 그래도 여러분이 나의 어려움에 함께 참여한 것은 참 잘한 일입니다.
ko.R: 그래도 여러분이 나의 어려운 때를 함께 나누어 준 것은 옳은 일이었습니다.

vi.L: Dù vậy, anh chị em đã làm điều tốt khi cùng dự phần hoạn nạn với tôi.
vi.B: Dù vậy, anh chị em đã làm một việc tốt đẹp khi chia sẻ hoạn nạn với tôi.
vi.R: Dù vậy, anh chị em đã làm điều đúng khi chia sẻ những lúc khó khăn với tôi.

pt.L: Contudo, vocês fizeram bem, participando juntos da minha aflição.
pt.B: Mesmo assim, vocês fizeram muito bem em tomar parte nas minhas dificuldades.
pt.R: Mesmo assim, vocês fizeram a coisa certa quando enfrentaram comigo os meus tempos difíceis.

am.L: ነገር ግን በመከራዬ አብራችሁ በመካፈላችሁ መልካም አደረጋችሁ።
am.B: ቢሆንም በችግሬ ተካፋዮች በመሆናችሁ መልካም ነገር አደረጋችሁ።
am.R: ያም ሆኖ የችግሬን ጊዜ ከእኔ ጋር በመካፈላችሁ ትክክለኛውን ነገር አደረጋችሁ።

decisions.choice: nevertheless: do not take my contentment as ingratitude
decisions.reason: Having said he can manage with little, Paul makes sure they do not think their gift was unwelcome or unneeded.

decisions.choice: became partners in my hardship
decisions.reason: συγκοινωνέω means to take a share in something together with someone. It belongs to the partnership words that run through the letter (1:5, 1:7). By sending help the Philippians joined in Paul's hardship; they did not only feel sorry for him.

decisions.choice: hardship, distress: here his imprisonment
alternatives: the troubles of the last days
decisions.reason: θλῖψις is pressure or distress of any kind. In this letter it is Paul's imprisonment and its hardships (1:17).

decisions.choice: took a share in
decisions.reason: Keeps the idea of becoming a partner, which verses 15-16 develop.

decisions.choice: hacerse partícipes de
decisions.reason: Keeps the idea of becoming partners, which verses 15-16 develop. Readable says "acompañarme": they stood with Paul by sending help.

source.text: Οἴδατε δὲ καὶ ὑμεῖς, Φιλιππήσιοι, ὅτι ἐν ἀρχῇ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου, ὅτε ἐξῆλθον ἀπὸ Μακεδονίας, οὐδεμία μοι ἐκκλησία ἐκοινώνησεν εἰς λόγον δόσεως καὶ λήμψεως εἰ μὴ ὑμεῖς μόνοι, ὅτι καὶ ἐν Θεσσαλονίκῃ καὶ ἅπαξ καὶ δὶς εἰς τὴν χρείαν μοι ἐπέμψατε.

records.literal_gloss: Know and also you, Philippians, that in [the] beginning of the gospel, when I went out from Macedonia, not one to me church shared in [an] account of giving and receiving except you alone, \v 16 that even in Thessalonica both once and twice for the need to me you sent.

en.L: And you yourselves also know, Philippians, that in [the] beginning of the gospel, when I went out from Macedonia, not one church shared with me in [an] account of giving and receiving except you alone; \v 16 for even in Thessalonica you sent [help] to me for [my] need both once and twice.
en.B: You know it yourselves, Philippians: in those first days of the gospel, when I left Macedonia, yours was the only church that went into partnership with me in an account of giving and receiving. \v 16 Even in Thessalonica you sent help for my needs more than once.
en.R: You Philippians know this yourselves. In the early days, when you had just heard the good news and I left Macedonia, your church was the only one that became my partner, giving and receiving. \v 16 Even while I was still in Thessalonica, you sent me help more than once when I needed it.

es.L: Y también {{plural_you:ustedes saben|vosotros sabéis}}, filipenses, que en [el] principio del evangelio, cuando salí de Macedonia, ninguna iglesia participó conmigo en [una] cuenta de dar y recibir, sino {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} solos; \v 16 pues aun en Tesalónica {{plural_you:me enviaron|me enviasteis}} [ayuda] para [mi] necesidad una y dos veces.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes mismos saben|Vosotros mismos sabéis}}, filipenses, que en aquellos primeros días del evangelio, cuando salí de Macedonia, {{plural_you:la de ustedes|la vuestra}} fue la única iglesia que se asoció conmigo en una cuenta de dar y recibir. \v 16 Incluso cuando estaba en Tesalónica, {{plural_you:me enviaron|me enviasteis}} ayuda para mis necesidades más de una vez.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes, filipenses, lo saben bien|Vosotros, filipenses, lo sabéis bien}}. Al principio, cuando {{plural_you:acababan|acababais}} de oír la buena noticia y yo salí de Macedonia, {{plural_you:la iglesia de ustedes|vuestra iglesia}} fue la única que se asoció conmigo, dando y recibiendo. \v 16 Incluso cuando todavía estaba en Tesalónica, {{plural_you:me enviaron|me enviasteis}} ayuda más de una vez cuando la necesitaba.

fr.L: Vous savez vous-mêmes aussi, Philippiens, qu’au commencement de l’Évangile, quand je suis parti de Macédoine, aucune église n’a été associée avec moi dans un compte de don et de réception, sinon vous seuls ; \v 16 car même à Thessalonique, vous m’avez envoyé [de l’aide] pour [mon] besoin, une fois et deux fois.
fr.B: Vous le savez vous-mêmes, Philippiens : dans ces premiers temps de l’Évangile, quand j’ai quitté la Macédoine, votre église a été la seule à s’associer avec moi en tenant un compte commun de ce qui était donné et reçu. \v 16 Même quand j’étais à Thessalonique, vous m’avez envoyé plus d’une fois de l’aide pour mes besoins.
fr.R: Vous, les Philippiens, vous le savez bien. Au début, quand vous veniez d’entendre la bonne nouvelle et que j’ai quitté la Macédoine, votre église a été la seule à devenir ma partenaire, pour donner et pour recevoir. \v 16 Même quand j’étais encore à Thessalonique, vous m’avez envoyé de l’aide plus d’une fois, quand j’en avais besoin.

sw.L: Ninyi wenyewe pia mnajua, Wafilipi, kwamba katika mwanzo wa Injili, nilipoondoka Makedonia, hakuna kanisa lolote lililoshiriki pamoja nami katika hesabu ya kutoa na kupokea, isipokuwa ninyi tu; \v 16 kwa sababu hata katika Thesalonike mlinitumia [msaada] kwa ajili ya mahitaji [yangu] mara moja na mara ya pili.
sw.B: Ninyi wenyewe mnajua, Wafilipi: katika siku zile za mwanzo za Injili, nilipoondoka Makedonia, kanisa lenu ndilo pekee lililoingia ubia nami katika hesabu ya kutoa na kupokea. \v 16 Hata nilipokuwa Thesalonike mlinitumia msaada kwa mahitaji yangu zaidi ya mara moja.
sw.R: Ninyi Wafilipi mnajua jambo hili wenyewe. Katika siku zile za mwanzo, mlipokuwa mmesikia Habari Njema punde tu na mimi nikaondoka Makedonia, kanisa lenu ndilo pekee lililokuwa mshirika wangu, mkitoa na kupokea. \v 16 Hata nilipokuwa bado Thesalonike, mlinitumia msaada zaidi ya mara moja nilipouhitaji.

ko.L: 빌립보 사람 여러분, 여러분도 알다시피, 복음의 초기에 내가 마게도냐를 떠날 때, 주고받는 계산에 나와 함께 참여한 교회는 여러분밖에 없었습니다. \v 16 데살로니가에 있을 때에도 여러분은 나의 필요를 위해 한 번, 또 두 번 [도움을] 보내 주었습니다.
ko.B: 빌립보 사람 여러분, 여러분 자신도 알고 있습니다. 복음이 처음 전해지던 때에 내가 마게도냐를 떠날 때, 주고받는 일에 나와 동역한 교회는 여러분밖에 없었습니다. \v 16 내가 데살로니가에 있을 때에도, 여러분은 여러 번 내게 필요한 것을 보내 주었습니다.
ko.R: 빌립보 사람 여러분, 여러분도 이것을 알고 있습니다. 여러분이 기쁜 소식을 처음 들었던 그 무렵, 내가 마게도냐를 떠날 때에, 나와 동역자가 되어 주고받는 일을 함께한 교회는 여러분의 교회뿐이었습니다. \v 16 내가 아직 데살로니가에 있을 때에도, 여러분은 내가 필요할 때마다 여러 번 도움을 보내 주었습니다.

vi.L: Và chính anh chị em cũng biết, thưa người Phi-líp, rằng lúc khởi đầu Tin Lành, khi tôi rời Ma-xê-đoan, không một Hội Thánh nào cùng tôi dự phần trong việc cho và nhận, ngoại trừ một mình anh chị em; \v 16 vì ngay cả khi tôi ở Tê-sa-lô-ni-ca, anh chị em đã gửi [giúp đỡ] cho nhu cầu của tôi một hai lần.
vi.B: Chính anh chị em biết điều đó, thưa anh chị em người Phi-líp: trong những ngày đầu của Tin Lành, khi tôi rời Ma-xê-đoan, Hội Thánh của anh chị em là Hội Thánh duy nhất đã cùng tôi chung phần trong việc cho và nhận. \v 16 Ngay cả khi tôi ở Tê-sa-lô-ni-ca, anh chị em đã nhiều lần gửi đồ giúp đỡ cho nhu cầu của tôi.
vi.R: Thưa anh chị em người Phi-líp, chính anh chị em biết điều này. Trong những ngày đầu, khi anh chị em mới nghe Tin Lành và tôi rời Ma-xê-đoan, Hội Thánh của anh chị em là Hội Thánh duy nhất đã cộng tác với tôi, cho và nhận. \v 16 Ngay cả khi tôi còn ở Tê-sa-lô-ni-ca, anh chị em đã hơn một lần gửi giúp đỡ cho tôi lúc tôi cần.

pt.L: E vocês mesmos também sabem, filipenses, que no princípio do evangelho, quando saí da Macedônia, nenhuma igreja teve parte comigo em [uma] conta de dar e receber, a não ser vocês somente; \v 16 pois até em Tessalônica vocês me enviaram [ajuda] para a [minha] necessidade, uma e duas vezes.
pt.B: Vocês mesmos sabem, filipenses: naqueles primeiros dias do evangelho, quando deixei a Macedônia, a igreja de vocês foi a única que se tornou minha parceira numa conta de dar e receber. \v 16 Até em Tessalônica vocês me mandaram ajuda para as minhas necessidades mais de uma vez.
pt.R: Vocês, filipenses, sabem disso. No começo, quando vocês tinham acabado de ouvir as boas-novas e eu saí da Macedônia, a igreja de vocês foi a única que se tornou minha parceira, dando e recebendo. \v 16 Mesmo quando eu ainda estava em Tessalônica, vocês me mandaram ajuda mais de uma vez quando precisei.

am.L: ፊልጵስዩሳውያን ሆይ፣ እናንተ ደግሞ ራሳችሁ ታውቃላችሁ፤ በወንጌል መጀመሪያ፣ ከመቄዶንያ በወጣሁ ጊዜ፣ ከእናንተ ብቻ በቀር በመስጠትና በመቀበል ሒሳብ ከእኔ ጋር የተካፈለች አንዲትም ቤተ ክርስቲያን አልነበረችም፤ \v 16 በተሰሎንቄ እንኳ ሳለሁ አንድ ጊዜም ሁለት ጊዜም ለችግሬ [እርዳታ] ልካችሁልኛልና።
am.B: ፊልጵስዩሳውያን ሆይ፣ እናንተ ራሳችሁ ታውቃላችሁ፤ በወንጌል መጀመሪያ ዘመን ከመቄዶንያ በወጣሁ ጊዜ በመስጠትና በመቀበል ሒሳብ ከእኔ ጋር የተባበረች ቤተ ክርስቲያን ከእናንተ በቀር ሌላ አልነበረችም። \v 16 በተሰሎንቄ እንኳ ሳለሁ ለችግሬ ከአንድ ጊዜ በላይ እርዳታ ልካችሁልኛል።
am.R: ፊልጵስዩሳውያን ሆይ፣ ይህን እናንተ ራሳችሁ ታውቃላችሁ። የምሥራቹን ገና እንደ ሰማችሁ በእነዚያ የመጀመሪያ ቀናት፣ መቄዶንያን ለቅቄ በሄድኩ ጊዜ፣ በመስጠትና በመቀበል አጋሬ የሆነች ቤተ ክርስቲያን የእናንተ ብቻ ነበረች። \v 16 ገና በተሰሎንቄ ሳለሁ እንኳ ባስፈለገኝ ጊዜ ከአንድ ጊዜ በላይ እርዳታ ልካችሁልኛል።

decisions.choice: the beginning of the gospel among them
alternatives: the beginning of the gospel everywhere
decisions.reason: Paul had been preaching for years before he came to Philippi (Galatians 1:17-2:1), so he means the start of the gospel in their region: his first visit to Macedonia, told in Acts 16.

decisions.choice: a shared account of giving and receiving
alternatives: in the matter of giving and receiving
decisions.reason: λόγος here is a bookkeeping word, an account, and "giving and receiving" was a common business phrase for payments made and received. Paul describes their gifts as a partnership with two sides: they gave him material help, and they received from him the gospel (compare Romans 15:27 and 1 Corinthians 9:11).

decisions.choice: the time when Paul moved on from Macedonia
decisions.reason: Acts 16-18 tells how Paul went from Philippi to Thessalonica and Berea, all in Macedonia, and then on to Athens and Corinth. The gifts to Thessalonica (verse 16) came while he was still in Macedonia, and 2 Corinthians 11:9 mentions help from Macedonia when he was in Corinth.

decisions.choice: more than once
decisions.reason: "Both once and twice" is an expression for repeated action; Paul uses the same phrase in 1 Thessalonians 2:18.

decisions.choice: went into partnership
decisions.reason: κοινωνέω is the verb of the partnership Paul thanks them for in 1:5: a commitment, not a single gift.

decisions.choice: [help], [my]
decisions.reason: The Greek has no object for "you sent"; Literal supplies the obvious one in brackets.

decisions.choice: when you had just heard the good news
alternatives: in the beginning of the good news
decisions.reason: Readable spells out what "the beginning of the gospel" means here (meaning note m1).

decisions.choice: [ayuda], [mi]
decisions.reason: As in English: the Greek has no object for "you sent"; Literal supplies the obvious one in brackets. Literal also keeps "una y dos veces"; Balanced and Readable say what the expression means (meaning decision m4).

decisions.choice: se asoció conmigo
decisions.reason: "Asociarse" is the word for going into partnership, including in business, which fits the account language of the verse (meaning decisions m2 and m5).

decisions.choice: la de ustedes / la vuestra
decisions.reason: "Su iglesia" could be read as "his church"; the setting spans keep the owner plain in both forms.

decisions.choice: cuando acababan de oír la buena noticia
decisions.reason: As in English: Readable spells out what "the beginning of the gospel" means here (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "주고받는 계산" (L); "주고받는 일" (B, R)
decisions.reason: A shared account of giving and receiving is a business phrase (the meaning decision), and verse 17 goes on with the account. Literal keeps "계산" (account); Balanced and Readable say the plain sense. "마게도냐" and "데살로니가" are the Protestant Korean forms, as in Romans 15:26.

decisions.choice: "thưa người Phi-líp" (L); "thưa anh chị em người Phi-líp" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Paul names the church by its city, the only time he does so in the letter. Literal keeps the bare name with the respectful "thưa"; Balanced and Readable add "anh chị em", the readers' word through the letter. "Hỡi" belongs to older speech.

decisions.choice: "việc cho và nhận" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The phrase is the language of a shared account (m2). Vietnamese "cho và nhận" is plain; "chung phần" (B) and "dự phần" (L) keep the partnership.

decisions.choice: filipenses (lowercase)
decisions.reason: Portuguese writes the people of a town in lowercase, even in address; "Filipenses" with a capital would read as the name of the book.

decisions.choice: በመስጠትና በመቀበል ሒሳብ (in an account of giving and receiving)
alternatives: በመስጠትና በመቀበል ጉዳይ (in the matter of giving and receiving)
decisions.reason: Paul uses the language of a shared business account (meaning decision), which he takes up again in verses 17-18; "ሒሳብ" keeps it, and the same word returns in verse 17.

source.text: οὐχ ὅτι ἐπιζητῶ τὸ δόμα, ἀλλὰ ἐπιζητῶ τὸν καρπὸν τὸν πλεονάζοντα εἰς λόγον ὑμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Not that I seek the gift, but I seek the fruit the increasing to account of you.

en.L: Not that I seek the gift, but I seek the fruit that increases to your account.
en.B: It is not the gift I am after. What I am after is the profit that keeps adding up in your account.
en.R: I am not hinting that I want more gifts. What I want is the good that comes back to you from your giving, growing like savings in an account.

es.L: No que busque el regalo, sino que busco el fruto que aumenta en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} cuenta.
es.B: No es el regalo lo que busco. Lo que busco es la ganancia que se va acumulando en {{plural_you:la cuenta de ustedes|vuestra cuenta}}.
es.R: No estoy insinuando que quiero más regalos. Lo que quiero es el bien que {{plural_you:ustedes reciben|vosotros recibís}} a cambio de dar, y que va creciendo como los ahorros en una cuenta.

fr.L: Non que je recherche le don, mais je recherche le fruit qui s’accroît à votre compte.
fr.B: Ce n’est pas le don que je cherche. Ce que je cherche, c’est le bénéfice qui ne cesse de s’ajouter à votre compte.
fr.R: Je ne veux pas vous faire comprendre que j’aimerais d’autres cadeaux. Ce que je veux, c’est le bien qui vous revient grâce à ce que vous donnez, et qui grandit comme une épargne sur un compte.

sw.L: Si kwamba natafuta zawadi, bali natafuta tunda linaloongezeka katika hesabu yenu.
sw.B: Si zawadi ninayoitafuta. Ninachokitafuta ni faida inayozidi kuongezeka katika hesabu yenu.
sw.R: Sidokezi kwamba nataka zawadi zaidi. Ninachotaka ni mema yanayowarudia ninyi kwa sababu ya kutoa kwenu, yakiongezeka kama akiba inayokua benki.

ko.L: 내가 선물을 구하는 것이 아니라, 여러분의 계산에 불어나는 열매를 구하는 것입니다.
ko.B: 내가 바라는 것은 선물이 아닙니다. 내가 바라는 것은 여러분의 장부에 계속 쌓여 가는 이익입니다.
ko.R: 내가 선물을 더 달라고 넌지시 말하는 것이 아닙니다. 내가 바라는 것은 여러분이 베푼 것 때문에 여러분에게 돌아올 좋은 것입니다. 그것은 통장에 쌓여 가는 저축처럼 늘어 갑니다.

vi.L: Không phải tôi tìm kiếm món quà, nhưng tôi tìm kiếm bông trái đang được thêm vào trương mục của anh chị em.
vi.B: Điều tôi tìm kiếm không phải là món quà. Điều tôi tìm kiếm là lợi tức không ngừng được cộng thêm vào trương mục của anh chị em.
vi.R: Tôi không có ý ngụ ý rằng tôi muốn thêm quà. Điều tôi muốn là những điều tốt đẹp đến với anh chị em nhờ việc anh chị em ban cho, ngày càng tăng lên như tiền tiết kiệm trong một trương mục.

pt.L: Não que eu busque o presente, mas busco o fruto que aumenta na conta de vocês.
pt.B: Não é o presente que eu procuro. O que eu procuro é o lucro que vai se acumulando na conta de vocês.
pt.R: Não estou dando a entender que quero mais presentes. O que quero é o bem que volta para vocês por causa do que vocês deram, crescendo como dinheiro guardado numa poupança.

am.L: ስጦታውን እንደምፈልግ አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን ለሒሳባችሁ የሚበዛውን ፍሬ እፈልጋለሁ።
am.B: የምፈልገው ስጦታውን አይደለም። የምፈልገው በሒሳባችሁ ላይ እየተጠራቀመ የሚሄደውን ትርፍ ነው።
am.R: ተጨማሪ ስጦታ እንደምፈልግ እየጠቆምኩ አይደለም። የምፈልገው ከስጦታችሁ ወደ እናንተ የሚመለሰውን መልካም ነገር ነው፤ ይህም በሒሳብ ውስጥ እንደሚጠራቀም ቁጠባ እያደገ ይሄዳል።

decisions.choice: not that I am angling for another gift
decisions.reason: A second disclaimer, like the one in verse 11: Paul's thanks are not a request for more.

decisions.choice: fruit: here, the return on an investment
alternatives: good character, the fruit of the Spirit
decisions.reason: In a passage full of business words, καρπός is the yield an investment produces. The gain is the Philippians', not Paul's.

decisions.choice: growing in your account
decisions.reason: λόγος is an account again, as in verse 15, and πλεονάζω means to increase. Their giving is like a deposit that keeps earning. The one who credits it is God, who will repay them (verse 19; compare Proverbs 19:17).

decisions.choice: profit that keeps adding up (B); growing like savings (R)
decisions.reason: "Fruit" on its own would suggest character, as in Galatians 5:22. Balanced and Readable keep the business picture; Literal keeps "fruit".

decisions.choice: la ganancia que se va acumulando (B); crece como los ahorros (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: "fruto" alone would suggest character. Balanced and Readable keep the business picture; Literal keeps "fruto". Balanced writes "la cuenta de ustedes" because "su cuenta" could be read as Paul's account, and the gain is theirs (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: "bông trái" (L); "lợi tức" (B); "tiền tiết kiệm trong một trương mục" (R); "trương mục" for the account
decisions.reason: The fruit here is the return on an investment (m2), growing in their account (m3). Literal keeps the picture of fruit; Balanced and Readable use the language of a bank account, as the English does.

source.text: ἀπέχω δὲ πάντα καὶ περισσεύω· πεπλήρωμαι δεξάμενος παρὰ Ἐπαφροδίτου τὰ παρ’ ὑμῶν, ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας, θυσίαν δεκτήν, εὐάρεστον τῷ θεῷ.

records.literal_gloss: I have received in full and all things and I abound; I have been filled having received from Epaphroditus the things from you, an aroma of fragrance, a sacrifice acceptable, well-pleasing to God.

en.L: But I have received all things in full, and I abound; I have been filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things from you, an aroma of fragrance, an acceptable sacrifice, well-pleasing to God.
en.B: Everything has been paid to me in full, and I have more than enough. Since Epaphroditus brought me what you sent, I have all I need. Your gift is a sweet-smelling offering, a sacrifice God accepts, one that pleases {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Think of this as my receipt: I have received everything in full, and more! Epaphroditus brought me your gifts, and now I have plenty. Your gifts are like a sacrifice offered to God, with a sweet smell. God gladly accepts them, and they please {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Pero lo he recibido todo por completo, y tengo abundancia; estoy lleno, habiendo recibido de Epafrodito lo que vino de parte de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, olor de fragancia, sacrificio aceptable, agradable a Dios.
es.B: Ya he recibido el pago completo, y tengo de sobra. Desde que Epafrodito me trajo lo que {{plural_you:ustedes enviaron|vosotros enviasteis}}, tengo todo lo que necesito. Lo que {{plural_you:me dieron|me disteis}} es una ofrenda de aroma agradable, un sacrificio que Dios acepta y que le agrada.
es.R: {{plural_you:Tomen|Tomad}} esto como mi recibo: lo he recibido todo, ¡y más todavía! Epafrodito me trajo lo que {{plural_you:ustedes me enviaron|vosotros me enviasteis}}, y ahora tengo de sobra. Esos regalos son como un sacrificio ofrecido a Dios, de aroma agradable. Dios los acepta con gusto, y le agradan.

fr.L: Or j’ai reçu le tout en plein paiement, et j’ai en abondance ; je suis comblé, ayant reçu d’Épaphrodite vos [dons], une odeur de parfum, un sacrifice acceptable, agréable à Dieu.
fr.B: Tout m’a été payé intégralement, et j’ai plus qu’il ne me faut. Depuis qu’Épaphrodite m’a apporté ce que vous avez envoyé, j’ai tout ce dont j’ai besoin. Votre don est une offrande au parfum agréable, un sacrifice que Dieu accepte et qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} plaît.
fr.R: Voyez ceci comme mon reçu : j’ai tout reçu, et même plus ! Épaphrodite m’a apporté vos cadeaux, et maintenant j’ai tout ce qu’il me faut. Vos cadeaux sont comme un sacrifice offert à Dieu, avec une odeur agréable. Dieu les accepte avec joie, et ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} plaisent.

sw.L: Lakini nimepokea yote kikamilifu, tena nina ziada; nimetoshelezwa, nikiwa nimepokea kutoka kwa Epafrodito mlivyonitumia, harufu nzuri ya kupendeza, dhabihu yenye kukubalika, inayompendeza Mungu.
sw.B: Nimelipwa kila kitu kikamilifu, na nina zaidi ya kutosha. Kwa kuwa Epafrodito ameniletea mlichonitumia, nina yote ninayohitaji. Zawadi yenu ni sadaka yenye harufu nzuri, dhabihu ambayo Mungu anaikubali na inayompendeza.
sw.R: Hii iwe kama risiti yangu: nimepokea kila kitu kikamilifu, na zaidi! Epafrodito ameniletea zawadi zenu, na sasa nina vingi. Zawadi zenu ni kama dhabihu iliyotolewa kwa Mungu, yenye harufu nzuri. Mungu anazipokea kwa furaha, nazo zinampendeza.

ko.L: 나는 모든 것을 다 받았고 넉넉합니다. 에바브로디도에게서 여러분이 보낸 것을 받아 풍족합니다. 그것은 향기로운 냄새요, 하나님께서 받으실 만한 제물이요, 하나님을 기쁘시게 하는 것입니다.
ko.B: 나는 모든 것을 다 받았고, 이제는 넉넉합니다. 여러분이 보낸 것을 에바브로디도에게서 받았으니, 필요한 것이 다 채워졌습니다. 여러분의 선물은 향기로운 제물이며, 하나님께서 받으시고 기뻐하시는 희생 제물입니다.
ko.R: 이것을 내 영수증으로 생각해 주십시오. 나는 모든 것을 다 받았고, 그보다 더 많이 받았습니다! 에바브로디도가 여러분의 선물을 가져왔고, 이제 나는 넉넉합니다. 여러분의 선물은 하나님께 드린 향기로운 제물과 같습니다. 하나님께서 그것을 기쁘게 받으시고, 그 선물을 기뻐하십니다.

vi.L: Nhưng tôi đã nhận đủ mọi thứ, và còn dư dật; tôi được đầy đủ vì đã nhận những gì anh chị em gửi đến qua Ép-ba-phô-đích, là một mùi hương thơm ngát, một của lễ được chấp nhận, đẹp lòng Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Tôi đã nhận đủ mọi thứ, và còn có nhiều hơn mức cần. Từ khi Ép-ba-phô-đích đem đến cho tôi những gì anh chị em gửi, tôi có tất cả những gì mình cần. Món quà của anh chị em là một của lễ có mùi thơm, một sinh tế Đức Chúa Trời chấp nhận, một của lễ làm đẹp lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Hãy xem đây như giấy biên nhận của tôi: tôi đã nhận đủ mọi thứ, và còn nhiều hơn nữa! Ép-ba-phô-đích đã đem quà của anh chị em đến cho tôi, và bây giờ tôi có dư dật. Quà của anh chị em giống như một của lễ dâng lên Đức Chúa Trời, có mùi thơm. Đức Chúa Trời vui lòng chấp nhận những món quà ấy, và chúng làm đẹp lòng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

pt.L: Mas recebi tudo por completo e tenho em abundância; estou plenamente suprido, tendo recebido de Epafrodito as coisas [vindas] de vocês, um aroma de bom perfume, um sacrifício aceitável, agradável a Deus.
pt.B: Tudo me foi pago por completo, e tenho mais do que o suficiente. Desde que Epafrodito me trouxe o que vocês mandaram, tenho tudo de que preciso. O presente de vocês é uma oferta de cheiro agradável, um sacrifício que Deus aceita e que {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} agrada.
pt.R: Considerem isto o meu recibo: recebi tudo por completo, e mais ainda! Epafrodito me trouxe os presentes de vocês, e agora tenho bastante. Os presentes de vocês são como um sacrifício oferecido a Deus, com um cheiro agradável. Deus aceita esses presentes com alegria, e eles agradam a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.

am.L: ነገር ግን ሁሉን በሙሉ ተቀብያለሁ፤ ተርፎኛልም፤ ከእናንተ የተላከውን ከአፍሮዲጡ ተቀብዬ ተሞልቻለሁ፤ [ይህም] መልካም መዓዛ ያለው ሽታ፣ ተቀባይነት ያለው መሥዋዕት፣ እግዚአብሔርን ደስ የሚያሰኝ ነው።
am.B: ሁሉም ነገር ሙሉ በሙሉ ተከፍሎኛል፤ ተርፎኛልም። ከእናንተ የላካችሁትን አፍሮዲጡ ስላመጣልኝ የሚያስፈልገኝ ሁሉ አለኝ። ስጦታችሁ መልካም መዓዛ ያለው መባ፣ እግዚአብሔር የሚቀበለውና እርሱን ደስ የሚያሰኝ መሥዋዕት ነው።
am.R: ይህን እንደ ደረሰኝ ቁጠሩት፤ ሁሉን ነገር በሙሉ ተቀብያለሁ፤ ከዚያም በላይ! አፍሮዲጡ ስጦታችሁን አመጣልኝ፤ አሁን ብዙ አለኝ። ስጦታችሁ ለእግዚአብሔር እንደሚቀርብ ጣፋጭ መዓዛ ያለው መሥዋዕት ነው። እግዚአብሔር በደስታ ይቀበለዋል፤ እርሱንም ደስ ያሰኘዋል።

decisions.choice: I have received in full: the wording of a receipt
decisions.reason: ἀπέχω was the usual word on business receipts of the time, found in many papyrus documents: "received in full". Paul closes the account of verses 15-17 with a receipt, half in jest.

decisions.choice: I am filled: fully supplied
decisions.reason: πληρόω is the same verb as "will fill" in verse 19. The Philippians have filled Paul's need; God will fill theirs.

decisions.choice: the language of the offerings in the Law
decisions.reason: "An aroma of fragrance" is the phrase the Greek Old Testament uses for offerings that please God (Genesis 8:21; Leviticus 1:9). Paul treats their gift to him as a gift offered to God, as Ephesians 5:2 says of Christ's giving of himself.

decisions.choice: Epaphroditus, the church's messenger
decisions.reason: Epaphroditus brought the gift from Philippi and nearly died while serving Paul (2:25-30).

decisions.choice: paid to me in full
decisions.reason: Keeps the receipt language of the Greek.

decisions.choice: Think of this as my receipt
decisions.reason: Readers today would miss the receipt wording; Readable says what Paul is doing.

decisions.choice: he recibido el pago completo
decisions.reason: Keeps the receipt language of the Greek (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: Tomen esto como mi recibo
decisions.reason: As in English: readers today would miss the receipt wording, so Readable says what Paul is doing.

decisions.choice: lo que vino de parte de ustedes (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek is "the things from you". "Lo que vino de parte de" says that in natural Spanish without adding a word the Greek lacks.

decisions.choice: "다 받았고" (L, B); "영수증" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the wording of a receipt, "paid in full" (the meaning decision). Korean "다 받았다" says that at Literal and Balanced; Readable names the receipt, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "đã nhận đủ" at every level; Readable names the receipt
decisions.reason: The verb is the wording of a receipt (m1). Vietnamese "đã nhận đủ" is what a receipt says; Readable makes the picture plain, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: estou plenamente suprido (4:18); suprirá (4:19)
decisions.reason: m2 links the two verbs: the Philippians have filled Paul's need, and God will fill theirs. "Encher uma necessidade" is not Portuguese, so both verses say "suprir", which keeps the link.

decisions.choice: ተከፍሎኛል (it has been paid to me, B); ይህን እንደ ደረሰኝ ቁጠሩት (count this as a receipt, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is the wording of a receipt (meaning decision m1). Balanced says it as a payment; Readable, like the English, names the receipt, and the Amharic "ደረሰኝ" (receipt, and 'it reached me') carries both senses at once.

source.text: ὁ δὲ θεός μου πληρώσει πᾶσαν χρείαν ὑμῶν κατὰ τὸ πλοῦτος αὐτοῦ ἐν δόξῃ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And the God of me will fill every need of you according to the riches of him in glory in Christ Jesus.

en.L: And my God will fill every need of yours according to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} riches in glory in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus.
en.B: And my God will fill every need you have, in keeping with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glorious wealth in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus.
en.R: And my God will give you everything you need. God's riches are glorious and great, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gives from them through {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus.

es.L: Y mi Dios llenará toda necesidad {{plural_you:de ustedes|vuestra}} conforme a sus riquezas en gloria en {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} Jesús.
es.B: Y mi Dios proveerá todo lo que {{plural_you:ustedes necesiten|vosotros necesitéis}}, conforme a su gloriosa riqueza en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús.
es.R: Y mi Dios {{plural_you:les dará todo lo que necesiten|os dará todo lo que necesitéis}}. Las riquezas de Dios son inmensas y gloriosas, y de ellas {{plural_you:les|os}} da por medio {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} Jesús.

fr.L: Et mon Dieu comblera tout votre besoin selon {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} richesse dans la gloire, {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus.
fr.B: Et mon Dieu comblera tous vos besoins, à la mesure de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} glorieuse richesse {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus.
fr.R: Et mon Dieu vous donnera tout ce dont vous avez besoin. Les richesses de Dieu sont glorieuses et immenses, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous en donne par le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus.

sw.L: Na Mungu wangu atalijaza kila hitaji lenu kulingana na utajiri {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ulio katika utukufu, katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu.
sw.B: Na Mungu wangu atawapa kila mnachohitaji, kulingana na utajiri {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mtukufu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu.
sw.R: Na Mungu wangu atawapa kila kitu mnachohitaji. Utajiri wa Mungu ni mkuu na wa utukufu, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} huwapa kutoka katika utajiri huo kupitia {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu.

ko.L: 그리고 나의 하나님께서 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 영광 가운데 있는 그분의 풍성함을 따라 여러분의 모든 필요를 채우실 것입니다.
ko.B: 그리고 나의 하나님께서 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 그분의 영광스러운 풍성함에 따라 여러분에게 필요한 모든 것을 채워 주실 것입니다.
ko.R: 그리고 나의 하나님께서 여러분에게 필요한 모든 것을 주실 것입니다. 하나님의 풍성함은 영광스럽고 크며, 하나님께서는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수를 통해 그 풍성함에서 여러분에게 주실 것입니다.

vi.L: Và Đức Chúa Trời của tôi sẽ đáp ứng mọi nhu cầu của anh chị em theo sự giàu có của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong vinh quang, trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu.
vi.B: Và Đức Chúa Trời của tôi sẽ đáp ứng mọi nhu cầu của anh chị em, tương xứng với sự giàu có vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.
vi.R: Và Đức Chúa Trời của tôi sẽ ban cho anh chị em mọi điều anh chị em cần. Sự giàu có của Đức Chúa Trời thật vinh quang và lớn lao, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban từ sự giàu có ấy qua Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.

pt.L: E o meu Deus suprirá toda necessidade de vocês segundo as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} riquezas em glória {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus.
pt.B: E o meu Deus suprirá todas as necessidades de vocês, de acordo com a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} gloriosa riqueza {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus.
pt.R: E o meu Deus vai dar a vocês tudo de que precisarem. As riquezas de Deus são gloriosas e grandes, e é delas que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} dá a vocês, por meio {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} Jesus.

am.L: አምላኬም ችግራችሁን ሁሉ በክብር ባለው ሀብቱ መጠን {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ ይሞላል።
am.B: አምላኬም ያላችሁን ማንኛውንም ችግር እንደ ክቡር ሀብቱ መጠን {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ ይሞላል።
am.R: አምላኬም የሚያስፈልጋችሁን ሁሉ ይሰጣችኋል። የእግዚአብሔር ሀብት ክቡርና ታላቅ ነው፤ ከዚያም {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ በኩል ይሰጣል።

decisions.choice: my God, in turn, will fill your need
decisions.reason: Paul cannot repay them himself, but the God he serves will. "Will fill" is the same verb as "I am filled" in verse 18: they filled Paul's need, and God will fill theirs.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "will fill", a promise
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts have a form of the verb that turns the promise into a wish. The SBLGNT, with most manuscripts, has the future: a promise.

decisions.choice: glorious riches: "in glory" describes God's wealth
alternatives: he will fill your needs in a glorious way
decisions.reason: The Greek allows "in glory" to go with "his riches" or with "will fill". We read it with "riches", which it follows directly: the wealth from which God gives is his own, as glorious as he is. The other reading says the giving itself will be glorious. The difference is small, but a footnote gives it.

decisions.choice: in keeping with his wealth, not merely out of it
decisions.reason: κατά means "in proportion to": God gives on the scale of what he has, not a token from a great store.

decisions.choice: every need
decisions.reason: χρεία is the same word used of Paul's needs in verse 16. It is a promise about what they need, given to people who had just given generously.

decisions.choice: in Christ Jesus: God gives through his people's union with Christ
decisions.reason: The phrase ends the sentence and covers the whole promise: God's supply comes to them in and through Christ Jesus.

decisions.choice: glorious wealth (B); riches are glorious (R)
decisions.reason: "Riches in glory" is often heard as "riches in heaven". The adjective keeps the key term and follows meaning decision m3; Literal keeps "in glory".

decisions.choice: through
decisions.reason: Readable says how God's giving reaches them (meaning decision m6).

decisions.choice: llenará (L); proveerá (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "llenar" to match "estoy lleno" in verse 18 (meaning decision m1). With "necesidad" as its object it is unusual Spanish, so Balanced uses "proveer", and Readable "dar".

decisions.choice: su gloriosa riqueza (B); son inmensas y gloriosas (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: "riquezas en gloria" is easily heard as "riches in heaven"; the adjective follows meaning decision m3. Balanced says "todo lo que ustedes necesiten" so that "su" is left for God alone.

decisions.choice: por medio {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}
decisions.reason: As in English: Readable says how God's giving reaches them (meaning decision m6).

decisions.choice: comblera (L, B)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one Paul has just used of himself in verse 18, "I have been filled" ("je suis comblé"): God will do for them what their gift did for him (m1). "Combler" keeps the echo, which "pourvoir" would lose.

decisions.choice: "theo sự giàu có" (L); "tương xứng với sự giàu có" (B)
decisions.reason: God gives in keeping with his wealth, not merely out of it (m4). "Tương xứng với" says that the gift matches the size of the riches.

source.text: τῷ δὲ θεῷ καὶ πατρὶ ἡμῶν ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων· ἀμήν.

records.literal_gloss: To the now God and Father of us the glory to the ages of the ages; amen.

en.L: Now to our God and Father [be] the glory to the ages of the ages. Amen.
en.B: Glory be to our God and Father for ever and ever. Amen.
en.R: Let all glory be given to our God and Father forever and ever. Amen.

es.L: Y a nuestro Dios y Padre [sea] la gloria por los siglos de los siglos. Amén.
es.B: Gloria a nuestro Dios y Padre por los siglos de los siglos. Amén.
es.R: ¡Que toda la gloria sea para nuestro Dios y Padre por siempre! Amén.

fr.L: Or à notre Dieu et Père [soit] la gloire aux siècles des siècles. Amen.
fr.B: Gloire à notre Dieu et Père pour toujours et à jamais. Amen.
fr.R: Que toute la gloire soit donnée à notre Dieu et Père, pour toujours et à jamais. Amen.

sw.L: Basi kwa Mungu na Baba yetu [uwe] utukufu milele na milele. Amina.
sw.B: Utukufu uwe kwa Mungu na Baba yetu milele na milele. Amina.
sw.R: Mungu na Baba yetu na apewe utukufu wote milele na milele. Amina.

ko.L: 우리 하나님 아버지께 영광이 영원무궁하도록 [있기를 빕니다]. 아멘.
ko.B: 우리 하나님 아버지께 영광이 영원히 있기를 빕니다. 아멘.
ko.R: 우리 하나님 아버지께서 영원히 모든 영광을 받으시기를 빕니다. 아멘.

vi.L: Nguyện vinh quang thuộc về Đức Chúa Trời, Cha chúng ta, đời đời vô cùng. A-men.
vi.B: Nguyện vinh quang thuộc về Đức Chúa Trời, Cha chúng ta, đời đời vô cùng. A-men.
vi.R: Nguyện mọi vinh quang đều được dâng lên Đức Chúa Trời, Cha chúng ta, mãi mãi đời đời. A-men.

pt.L: E ao nosso Deus e Pai [seja] a glória pelos séculos dos séculos. Amém.
pt.B: Glória ao nosso Deus e Pai para todo o sempre. Amém.
pt.R: Que toda a glória seja dada ao nosso Deus e Pai para todo o sempre. Amém.

am.L: ለአምላካችንና ለአባታችን ክብር እስከ ዘመናት ዘመናት [ይሁን]። አሜን።
am.B: ለአምላካችንና ለአባታችን ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ክብር ይሁን። አሜን።
am.R: ክብር ሁሉ ለአምላካችንና ለአባታችን ለዘላለም ይሁን። አሜን።

decisions.choice: glory be given: an act of praise
decisions.reason: The Greek has no verb. Paul's other outbursts of praise (Romans 11:36; Galatians 1:5) are likewise praise offered, not information. "The glory" has the article: the glory that rightly belongs to God.

decisions.choice: God, who is our Father
alternatives: God, and our Father, as two persons
decisions.reason: One article covers both nouns, so they name the same person, as in 1:2.

decisions.choice: for ever and ever
alternatives: to the ages of the ages
decisions.reason: Literally "to the ages of the ages": a way of saying without end.

decisions.choice: Amen: "it is true, let it be so"
decisions.reason: ἀμήν is a Hebrew word carried over into Greek untranslated. Hearers said it to join in what was said.

decisions.choice: Amen
decisions.reason: Kept untranslated, as the Greek itself kept it; the word is familiar from prayer.

decisions.choice: por los siglos de los siglos (L, B); por siempre (R)
decisions.reason: "Por los siglos de los siglos" is both the literal wording and the phrase Spanish speakers know from prayer, so Literal and Balanced use it. Readable says "por siempre". "Amén" is kept, as in English.

decisions.choice: እስከ ዘመናት ዘመናት (to the ages of the ages, L); ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም / ለዘላለም (B, R)
alternatives: ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም at every level
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek's doubled 'ages'; Balanced and Readable use the Amharic idiom for 'for ever and ever'.

source.text: Ἀσπάσασθε πάντα ἅγιον ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Greet every holy one in Christ Jesus.

en.L: Greet every holy one in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus.
en.B: Greet every one of God's holy people in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus.
en.R: Give my greetings to every one of God's people who belongs to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus.

es.B: {{plural_you:Saluden|Saludad}} a cada miembro del pueblo santo de Dios en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús.
es.R: {{plural_you:Saluden|Saludad}} de mi parte a cada miembro del pueblo de Dios que pertenece {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} Jesús.

fr.L: Saluez chaque saint {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus.
fr.B: Saluez chacun des membres du peuple saint de Dieu {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus.
fr.R: Saluez de ma part chacun des membres du peuple de Dieu qui appartient au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus.

sw.B: Msalimuni kila mmoja wa watu watakatifu wa Mungu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu.
sw.R: Nisalimieni kila mmoja wa watu wa Mungu aliye wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu.

ko.L: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에 있는 모든 성도에게 문안하십시오.
ko.B: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에 있는 모든 성도에게 한 사람 한 사람 문안해 주십시오.
ko.R: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수께 속한 하나님의 백성 한 사람 한 사람에게 내 안부를 전해 주십시오.

vi.L: Hãy chào mỗi thánh đồ trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu.
vi.B: Hãy chào từng người trong dân thánh của Đức Chúa Trời trong Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.
vi.R: Xin chào thăm từng người trong dân thánh của Đức Chúa Trời, là những người thuộc về Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.

pt.L: Saúdem cada santo {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus.
pt.B: Saúdem cada um do povo santo de Deus {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus.
pt.R: Saúdem por mim cada pessoa do povo de Deus que pertence {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}} Jesus.

am.L: {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ ያለውን ቅዱስ ሁሉ ሰላም በሉ።
am.B: ከእግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ሕዝብ መካከል {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ ያለውን እያንዳንዱን ሰላም በሉ።
am.R: {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ኢየሱስ ከሆኑት የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ እያንዳንዱን ሰላም በሉልኝ።

decisions.choice: a holy one: a believer set apart as God's own
alternatives: a saint, a specially holy person
decisions.reason: ἅγιος describes every believer, not a select few; Paul greets the whole church this way in 1:1. Their holiness comes from God's claim on them, not from their own achievement.

decisions.choice: every single one
decisions.reason: The Greek is singular, "every holy one": each believer is greeted, with no one left out.

decisions.choice: holy in Christ Jesus
alternatives: greet them in Christ Jesus, as a fellow believer
decisions.reason: The phrase could go with "greet" or with "holy one". The same words describe the believers in 1:1, "the holy ones in Christ Jesus", so we read it with "holy one".

decisions.choice: holy one (L); God's holy people (B); God's people (R)
decisions.reason: "Saint" now usually means an exceptionally holy person, often one honored by a church after death. Paul means every believer.

decisions.choice: Give my greetings to
decisions.reason: The greeting comes from Paul through the church; Readable makes the sense of the command plain.

decisions.choice: santo (L); pueblo santo de Dios (B); pueblo de Dios (R)
decisions.reason: Spanish has one word, "santo", for both "holy one" and "saint", and "un santo" now usually means someone canonized. Literal keeps the word; Balanced and Readable say what Paul means: every believer, set apart as God's own.

decisions.choice: {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}
decisions.reason: The setting span takes in the preposition, because Spanish contracts "a el" to "al".

decisions.choice: "문안하다" (L, B); "안부를 전하다" (R), through these greetings
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 4:10-15: "문안하다" is the formal word for sending greetings in a letter; Readable uses the everyday "안부를 전하다".

source.text: ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς οἱ σὺν ἐμοὶ ἀδελφοί.

records.literal_gloss: Greet you the with me brothers.

en.L: The {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} with me greet you.
en.B: The {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} who are with me send you greetings.
en.R: The {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} who are here with me send you their greetings.

es.B: Los hermanos que están conmigo {{plural_you:les|os}} envían saludos.
es.R: Los hermanos que están aquí conmigo {{plural_you:les|os}} mandan saludos.

fr.L: Les {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} [qui sont] avec moi vous saluent.
fr.B: Les {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} qui sont avec moi vous saluent.
fr.R: Les {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} qui sont ici avec moi vous envoient leurs salutations.

sw.B: Ndugu walio pamoja nami wanawatumia salamu.
sw.R: Ndugu walio hapa pamoja nami wanawatumia salamu zao.

ko.R: 이곳에서 나와 함께 있는 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들이 여러분에게 안부를 전합니다.

vi.L: Các {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} ở với tôi chào anh chị em.
vi.B: Các {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} đang ở với tôi gửi lời chào anh chị em.

pt.L: Os {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}} que [estão] comigo saúdam vocês.
pt.B: Os {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}} que estão comigo mandam saudações a vocês.
pt.R: Os {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}} que estão aqui comigo mandam saudações para vocês.

am.L: ከእኔ ጋር ያሉት {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሰላም ይሏችኋል።
am.B: ከእኔ ጋር ያሉት {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሰላምታ ይልኩላችኋል።
am.R: እዚህ ከእኔ ጋር ያሉት {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሰላምታቸውን ይልኩላችኋል።

decisions.choice: fellow believers with Paul, probably his co-workers
alternatives: all the believers where Paul is
decisions.reason: Verse 22 greets from "all the holy ones", so "the brothers with me" is probably the smaller circle working with Paul, such as Timothy (2:19-22). The word includes women when it means fellow believers, and Paul's co-workers included women (4:2-3). Whether women were in this group is not known.

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: No specific men are named and the word is the one used for fellow believers, so the inclusive default applies. Traditional is one tap away.

decisions.choice: hermanos, no setting
decisions.reason: As in 4:1: Spanish "hermanos" already covers brothers and sisters. Here it also leaves open, as the Greek does, whether women were in the group (meaning decision m1).

source.text: ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς πάντες οἱ ἅγιοι, μάλιστα δὲ οἱ ἐκ τῆς Καίσαρος οἰκίας.

en.L: All the holy ones greet you, but especially those of Caesar's household.

en.R: All of God's people here send you greetings, especially the believers who serve in the emperor's household.

es.L: {{plural_you:Los|Os}} saludan todos los santos, y especialmente los de la casa del César.

es.R: Todo el pueblo de Dios que está aquí {{plural_you:les|os}} manda saludos, especialmente los creyentes que están al servicio del emperador.

fr.L: Tous les saints vous saluent, mais surtout ceux de la maison de César.

sw.L: Watakatifu wote wanawasalimu, hasa wale wa nyumbani mwa Kaisari.

sw.R: Watu wote wa Mungu walio hapa wanawatumia salamu, hasa waamini wanaofanya kazi katika nyumba ya mfalme wa Rumi.

ko.L: 모든 성도가 여러분에게 문안하며, 특히 가이사의 집안 사람들이 [문안합니다].
ko.B: 이곳의 모든 성도가 여러분에게 문안합니다. 특히 황제의 집안 사람들이 문안합니다.
ko.R: 이곳에 있는 하나님의 모든 백성이 여러분에게 안부를 전합니다. 특히 황제의 집안에서 일하는 믿는 사람들이 안부를 전합니다.

vi.L: Tất cả các thánh đồ chào anh chị em, nhất là những người thuộc nhà của Sê-sa.

vi.R: Tất cả dân thánh của Đức Chúa Trời ở đây gửi lời chào anh chị em, nhất là các tín hữu đang phục vụ trong hoàng cung.

pt.R: Todo o povo de Deus daqui manda saudações a vocês, especialmente os seguidores de Jesus que servem na casa do imperador.

am.L: ቅዱሳን ሁሉ፣ ይልቁንም ከቄሳር ቤተ ሰዎች የሆኑት ሰላም ይሏችኋል።
am.B: እዚህ ያሉት የእግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ሕዝብ ሁሉ፣ በተለይም በንጉሠ ነገሥቱ ቤት ያሉት፣ ሰላም ይሏችኋል።
am.R: እዚህ ያሉት የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ሁሉ ሰላምታ ይልኩላችኋል፤ በተለይም በንጉሠ ነገሥቱ ቤተ መንግሥት የሚያገለግሉት አማኞች።

decisions.choice: the emperor's staff: slaves and freed slaves in the imperial service
decisions.reason: "Caesar's household" was the large body of slaves and former slaves who ran the emperor's affairs, in Rome and in the provinces; many of them are named in inscriptions. It does not mean his relatives. That believers were among them shows the gospel had reached the heart of Roman government, as Paul hints in 1:13.

decisions.choice: Paul writes from a place where imperial servants are believers, most likely Rome
alternatives: Ephesus or Caesarea, where imperial servants also worked
decisions.reason: The letter does not name the place. Members of the imperial household served in Rome and in provincial centers, so this greeting does not settle the question on its own; with the palace guard in 1:13 it fits Rome best.

decisions.choice: holy ones: believers
decisions.reason: As in verse 21: all believers, set apart as God's own.

decisions.choice: the emperor's household
decisions.reason: By Paul's day "Caesar" was the emperor's title, not only a name; Literal keeps "Caesar".

decisions.choice: here
decisions.reason: The holy ones who greet them are the believers where Paul is; "here" makes that clear.

decisions.choice: la casa del emperador (B); al servicio del emperador (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: "César" was by now the emperor's title; Literal keeps it. Readable says "al servicio de" because "casa" alone could be heard as his family (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: santos (L); pueblo santo de Dios (B); pueblo de Dios (R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 21.

decisions.choice: Kaisari (L, B); mfalme wa Rumi (R)
decisions.reason: Swahili names the emperor "Kaisari", as 1 Peter 2:13 does; Readable says "mfalme wa Rumi" (the emperor of Rome) for new readers. "Nyumba" here is the household, the people who served the emperor, as the English Readable makes plain.

decisions.choice: "가이사의 집안" (L); "황제의 집안" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "가이사" is the established Protestant form of Caesar (docs/korean-style.md section 5), kept at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "황제" (emperor), as the English does. The household is the emperor's staff, slaves and freed slaves (the meaning decision), which Readable says.

decisions.choice: "nhà của Sê-sa" (L); "hoàng cung" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The household was the emperor's staff, slaves and freed slaves in imperial service (m1), not his relatives. Literal keeps "Sê-sa", the form of the Vietnamese Gospels; Balanced and Readable say "hoàng cung", the emperor's palace and its servants, as the English says "the emperor's household".

decisions.choice: os seguidores de Jesus
decisions.reason: Where the English Readable says "the believers", Portuguese avoids "os crentes", which in Brazil means Protestants in particular.

decisions.choice: የቄሳር ቤተ ሰዎች (L); በንጉሠ ነገሥቱ ቤት ያሉት (B); በንጉሠ ነገሥቱ ቤተ መንግሥት የሚያገለግሉት (R)
decisions.reason: The household meant is the emperor's staff of slaves and freedmen (meaning decision m1), not his family; "ቤተሰብ" would mean relatives, so Literal says the people of Caesar's house and the other levels name the emperor's service.

source.text: ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ τοῦ πνεύματος ὑμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ with the spirit of you.

en.R: May the grace of the Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} be with you, deep in your spirit.

es.L: La gracia del Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús Mesías}} [sea] con {{plural_you:el espíritu de ustedes|vuestro espíritu}}.

es.R: Que la gracia del Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} esté con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, en lo más profundo de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} espíritu.

fr.L: La grâce du Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}} [soit] avec votre esprit.

fr.R: Que la grâce du Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} soit avec vous, au plus profond de votre esprit.

sw.L: Neema ya Bwana Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} [iwe] pamoja na roho yenu.

sw.R: Neema ya Bwana Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} iwe pamoja nanyi, ndani kabisa ya roho zenu.

ko.L: 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 은혜가 여러분의 영과 함께 [있기를 빕니다].

ko.R: 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 은혜가 여러분의 영 깊은 곳에 함께 있기를 빕니다.

vi.R: Cầu xin ân điển của Chúa Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} ở cùng anh chị em, trong sâu thẳm tâm linh anh chị em.

pt.L: A graça do Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} [seja] com o espírito de vocês.
pt.B: Que a graça do Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} esteja com o espírito de vocês.
pt.R: Que a graça do Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} esteja com vocês, bem no fundo do espírito de vocês.

am.B: የጌታ የኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ጸጋ ከመንፈሳችሁ ጋር ይሁን።

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "with your spirit"
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts read "with you all", the ending of some other letters (2 Thessalonians 3:18). Many manuscripts also add "Amen". The SBLGNT reading matches the endings of Galatians 6:18 and Philemon 25. The meaning is much the same.

decisions.choice: your spirit: you at the deepest level
decisions.reason: πνεῦμα is singular with a plural "your": the inner life of each of them, and perhaps their shared life as one church (1:27, "one spirit"). It does not refer to the Holy Spirit here.

decisions.choice: a prayer: may grace be with you
alternatives: a statement: grace is with you
decisions.reason: There is no verb. As with closing greetings generally, it is a blessing prayed over the readers.

decisions.choice: the letter ends where it began, with grace
decisions.reason: Paul opened with grace and peace (1:2) and closes with grace, the undeserved kindness of the Lord Jesus.

decisions.choice: with you, deep in your spirit
decisions.reason: "With your spirit" can sound odd in plain speech; Readable says the grace is with them, at the deepest level, and keeps the word "spirit".

decisions.choice: el espíritu de ustedes
decisions.reason: Right after "el Señor Jesús", "su espíritu" could be read as his spirit. "El espíritu de ustedes" keeps the owner plain; vosotros has "vuestro".

decisions.choice: con ustedes, en lo más profundo de su espíritu
decisions.reason: As in English: Readable says the grace is with them, at the deepest level, and keeps the word "espíritu".

decisions.choice: {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}}
decisions.reason: Spanish writes the name and title as one word, "Jesucristo"; "Jesús Cristo" is not normal Spanish. The setting span takes in the name so the Messiah form can read "Jesús, el Mesías".
